thread:
marta: Evening swap — quick FYI before I head out. Few noisy signals and one degraded encoder replica to keep an eye on. :wave:

marta: Summary (non-customer-facing):
- preftech_kv_latency: intermittent flapping alerts (high rollups during bursts)
- ttl_eviction_rate: sporadic spikes on eu-region (noisy)
- encoder-pool-1: 1/3 replicas Ready (CrashLoopBackOff) on node-12

sam: thx — any user impact observed?

marta: No errors surfaced to customers, tail latency still within SLO for now. The encoder pod started OOM/killed yesterday during a batch job. I cordoned node-12 and attempted a restart, but pod remains CrashLoopBackOff.

jules: can you paste the pod name/last crash log?

marta: Pod: `encoder-pool-1-5c9b7d`
Last lines from `kubectl logs --previous`:
```
2026-03-18T17:44:12Z ERROR runtime: Memory exceeded, OOM kill
2026-03-18T17:44:13Z INFO restarting process
```

marta: Quick health commands: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=encoder-pool
kubectl -n inference describe pod encoder-pool-1-5c9b7d
kubectl -n inference logs encoder-pool-1-5c9b7d --previous
```

oncall-bot: Deploy completed: inference/encoder 2026-03-18T18:12Z (sha: a1b2c3) :white_check_mark:

kevin: I can take restart in ~30m during my window. If it restarts and keeps flapping we should scale to 4 temporarily and drain node-12 for deeper inspection.

sara: I'm suppressing the staging `prefetch_kv_latency` alert for 1h to cut noise; not touching prod alerts. Left a note in the alert runbook.

sam: For KV drift mitigation reminder: run the prefix compaction tool if you see kv prefix growth: `tools/kv/compact --prefix=enc`

marta: Added fallback route note in the coverage doc: if tail-latency > 1200ms promote `eu-fallback-lowmem` route. Also created internal ticket INCID-2026 to track encoder replica flaps and TTL tuning.

jules: question — should we tune TTL eviction alert threshold or keep as-is?

marta: Prefer tuning over full mute. I've proposed raising the sensitivity window from 3m -> 10m for now to reduce false positives while we investigate.

kevin: If it escalates, ping me directly and @eng-sre. I'll take primary.

sam: Leaving this watchlist for the night: encoder pod crashloop, prefetch_kv_latency flap, ttl_eviction spikes. I'm oncall until 02:00 UTC.

marta: Thanks all — passing off. If you need me after 19:30 UTC DM. :thumbsup:
